Title: Osaka:  Enjoy to the fullest! Only a guide knows! Namba gourmet tour!
Description:
[Starting from Dotonbori, the mecca of Osaka gourmet food!]
The tour begins in front of the Kuidare Building, a symbol of Namba, Osaka.
The "Kuidare Doll" standing in front of it, with its colorful costume and humorous expression, is a symbol of Osaka's food culture. Once you meet up with your local guide here, your gourmet tour of the "city of food to your heart's content" will begin! Dotonbori is a gourmet treasure trove filled with Osaka's representative soul foods, such as takoyaki, okonomiyaki, and kushikatsu. The streets are lined with steaming food stalls and shop fronts exuding fragrant aromas, and just walking around will whet your appetite. Many dishes are served in a takeout style, so one of the attractions is that you can casually enjoy eating while walking around. Although it is a tourist destination, Dotonbori has a nostalgic and friendly atmosphere. Experience the charm of Osaka with all your senses while surrounded by the smiles and energy of the local people.
[Enjoy Osaka's "deep gourmet" in Ura-Namba and Hozenji Yokocho!]
Next, we will visit a hidden spot known as "Ura Namba" and "Hozenji Yokocho," where Osaka's food culture is strongly alive. A little away from the hustle and bustle of tourist spots, this area is home to long-established and unique restaurants that have been loved by locals for many years. The soft lights of lanterns sway along the narrow stone-paved alleys, creating a nostalgic scene. As you walk through the space that makes you feel like you've traveled back in time to the Showa era, your steps will naturally slow down. As the night deepens, the laughter of regular customers and the sounds of clinking glasses echo throughout the area, and the whole town is enveloped in a warm and lively atmosphere. In this area, not only the taste of each restaurant, such as yakitori, kushiage, teppanyaki, sushi, takoyaki, and okonomiyaki, is one of the attractions, but also the personality of the owner and the atmosphere inside the restaurant. Rather than tasting the food, it may be closer to the feeling of "enjoying the space itself." It's like touring a food theme park, where you will encounter one delicious dish after another, satisfying both your stomach and your heart - this is the kind of gourmet experience you can only have in Osaka.
[Commemorative photo taken at a famous spot in Osaka!]
If you come to Osaka, this spot is a must-visit for photography!
Dotonbori is a town that shows a completely different look during the day and at night. During the day, it is crowded with tourists and has a bright and lively atmosphere, but when the sun goes down, its appearance changes completely. When the neon lights come on and the streets along the river start to shine fantastically, the night world spreads out like a scene from a movie. Dotonbori at night is a place where you can get a glimpse of the "true feelings of Osaka people". The sight of local people gathering and laughing casually while enjoying food and drinks is somehow warm and very unique. The fragrant smell of takoyaki, the sound of frying kushikatsu, and the laughter of passersby mix together, allowing you to experience the night of Osaka with all five senses. At the end of this gourmet tour, you will surely realize that the town of Dotonbori is not just a tourist spot, but a "living Osaka" where culture and human kindness breathe. Its special charm remains deep in the hearts of those who visit, and has a mysterious attraction that makes them want to return again and again.

Title: Osaka : Temaki Sushi and Tempura Cooking Class @SAKURA
Description:
Come cook in SAKURA with Chef Takuma, a passionate chef with 25 years of experience from Kyushu. In this hands-on Osaka class, you’ll create your own delicious temaki sushi and crispy tempura using the freshest seafood and seasonal veggies—all while soaking up the rich traditions of Japanese culture.

In this class, you’ll start by learning how to prepare temaki sushi, rolling fresh seafood and crisp vegetables into perfect hand rolls. Then, dive into the art of tempura, where you get to customize your dish by choosing your favorite seafood and vegetables to be lightly battered and fried to a golden crisp.

Hosted at a welcoming restaurant that serves Japanese, Western, and Chinese cuisine, the venue comfortably accommodates large groups and welcomes families with children (culinary fun for all ages, truly!). Whether you’re traveling solo, with friends, or with family, this class is designed to be enjoyable, educational, and suitable for all ages and skill levels.

In a nutshell, this experience goes beyond cooking. Chef Takuma shares the rich history and traditions behind sushi and tempura, turning each dish into a story you can taste and feel. You’ll leave inspired, carrying the true flavors of Japan with you to recreate at home.

Title: Osaka：Become the Legend   Step into the Soul of the Samurai
Description:
Tour Highlights

  • Explore the iconic Osaka Castle, a symbol of samurai power and Japan’s feudal history
  • Wear authentic-style samurai costumes and transform into a warrior
  • Learn basic katana movements from a professional instructor
  • Enjoy an action-style performance set to music – feel like a movie star!
  • Take unforgettable photos with your instructor in full samurai gear
  • Perfect for families, friends, and first-time visitors to Japan

"Be a Samurai in Osaka: Castle Visit & Warrior Experience" is the perfect short adventure for those who want more than just sightseeing.

Start your journey at the historic Osaka Castle, once the stronghold of Japan’s most powerful warlord. Then, step into the shoes of a real samurai—dress in traditional armor, wield a katana (practice sword), and learn the basic moves of this noble warrior class.

With guidance from skilled instructors, you’ll train, perform, and strike a pose like a samurai in action. Capture the moment with stunning photos in full costume, and take home memories that last a lifetime.

Title: Nara: Mindful Journey-Yoga and Buddhist Practices at a Historic Temple in Nara
Description:
Highlights

  • Practice yoga and meditation in the serene halls of the oldest Buddhist temple in Shigi mountain.
  • Try traditional Japanese spiritual arts like shakyō (sutra copying) or shabutsu (image tracing)
  • Enjoy quiet time for self-reflection, temple walks, and mindful exploration
  • Learn about Zen philosophy and Buddhist practices in an authentic setting
  • Immerse yourself in Japanese culture beyond the usual tourist spots
  • Perfect for solo travelers, wellness seekers, and those needing a deep breath in nature
  • Only 1 hour from Osaka – an ideal escape from the city

    “A Mindful Escape in Japan: Yoga & Zen Day Retreat at a Sacred Temple”

Step away from the busy world and into the peaceful heart of Japan’s spiritual heritage. Nestled in the mountains of Nara, one of the oldest temples in Shigisan offers the perfect setting for a day of yoga, self-discovery, and traditional Buddhist practices.

Your journey begins with a gentle yoga session in a centuries-old temple space, surrounded by tranquility. Afterward, immerse yourself in Japanese culture through shakyō (sutra copying) or shabutsu (image tracing) — ancient practices used to calm the mind and center the heart.

Bring your own lunch(there are a few local restaurants) and enjoy a peaceful break on temple grounds, followed by an afternoon yoga practice focused on relaxation and inner stillness. You’ll also have time to explore the temple gardens, visit sacred sites, or simply rest and reflect.

This experience is more than just a yoga class — it’s a rare opportunity to connect with Japan’s spiritual roots, recharge your energy, and return home feeling refreshed and inspired.

Title: Kobe : Akashi Fishing Trip with Sushi Lunch
Description:
• Savor a fresh sushi lunch made with the fish you catch during the trip

Begin your day with a 4:00 AM pickup from your hotel in the Kobe or Osaka area. Head to the Akashi Strait, one of Japan’s most famous fishing areas, known for red sea bream and octopus.

Board a boat and try catching seasonal fish such as red sea bream, flounder, octopus, and more. Enjoy the guidance of a private English-speaking driver-guide, who will assist you from hotel pickup to drop-off.

Return to port and savor a special sushi meal using the fish you caught. After lunch, relax on the journey back to your hotel, arriving between 3:00 and 4:00 PM.
